notes.title: Demo Update V0.5 available!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][b]Welcome to Steam Next Fest![/b] [/p][p]We're excited to be part of this amazing event alongside so many talented developers. To mark the occasion, we've released a brand-new [b]demo[/b] of [i]Sea of Brave Beast Island[/i], created especially for Next Fest![/p][p][i]Sea of Brave Beast Island[/i] is a single-player, tactical, turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Join Aidan on his perilous journey through Benryu Island as he battles the minions of the fearsome Captain Kingg and uncovers the island’s hidden secrets.[/p][p]Build a unique deck as you progress, discovering powerful new cards, recruiting allies, and upgrading your strategy with every fight.[/p][p]We can’t wait for you to dive in and let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/bd0dd35c593fb9d25524f4317bdda3f97fbf1835.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/f73555b9ae357441962b8f5fc2fd44ad37bbadc0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/e0a8c732b3ea775d7bdff7b8364b870b7cebc80c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/1f07dafbb17a3cc3f7c590108a0815a74d0eafcd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update V0.4 available!
notes.content:
Hello!

We share the new update of the demo, which incorporates new sections of the game implemented. Like the treasure caves, where you will advance through the squares based on your luck with the dice, dodging the bombs, we think it's great to include and enhance the use of the dice in conjunction with the cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/37c0941f3b5ef8f149ee59899a6de6600a270ab3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/6d702bf607c7ff639b0849a5383ac7b05688ed45.png[/img]

You will also find special crystals in the caves, which can enhance the recovery, attack, defense or energy points of the cards in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/67a840b06cfce8e8a4e85bd0f4496a026325b7fc.png[/img]

We invite you to try the demo, for our part we continue working and enjoying the development of the game, to deliver an entertaining experience.

Thank you :)

notes.title: Demo Update V0.3 available!
notes.content:
Hello!

We continue working hard on the development of Sea of ​​Brave Beast Island, this time we share a new update of the demo version (V0.3), in which several aspects were improved, such as:

[list]
[*] Information boards, winning, losing, card prizes, among others.
[*] New transitions between sections were included
[*] The map of chapter 1.
[*] Pause menu.
[*] A new mid-boss was added, a stylish crab, who comes to destroy your defenses.
[*] We reviewed and adjusted the options menu, the resolutions, so that it can be adjusted correctly the first time you start on Steam Deck.
[*] General performance improvements.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/0ad773ef2dc1660cbbc57d47581c98c416d40f75.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/b547d29b0938ebbfa0ab6fbd8e493fbb5e17d241.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/8fc68324c5ff9fe3dff803dce75dd9de2df8029a.png[/img]

We are also pleased to tell you that we made a major update to Sea of ​​Brave Aidan Adventure (V.09), where we visually improved different sections of the game, always thinking of a better gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/41aef317ff813f0d24857576b0a63f84377fbfc2.png[/img]

Thank you.

notes.title: Demo Update V0.2 available!
notes.content:
Hello,

Thanks for your feedback, we made the following adjustments to the demo:
[list]
[*] We added the option to modify the resolution in the Options section.
[*] We improved some sections where continually repeating the accept button caused errors.
[*] We upgraded the enemy mid-boss character, giving him the spike damage ability, to improve combat.
[*] We improved the enemy character Hedgehog Boss, giving him the ability to poison, to improve combat.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/567c6f133f7c1c49d1791774f6f9ce26b61ca7df.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/5c85f147c8e520b21bf36fb7f31978bacafeb437.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031871/dd1bb05885e7533ff2a19e639ecabbee522e1413.png[/img]

Thank you.
